intro: Creator commentary, documented influences and answers for shared readers. This section is curated separately from the fictional universe; private research and working notes are not published automatically.

influence.title: God Loves, Man Kills
influence.text: The project's recorded inspiration identifies the God Loves, Man Kills graphic novel as a major influence on Film 4's plot and themes. The treatment also places Xavier out of action, leaving Cyclops and Magneto at the center of its leadership conflict.
influence.reference: Final Master Project Index — Film 4 inspirations, A11/A12

faq.question: What is this project?
faq.answer: A personal fictional X-Men saga built around five central films, with related projects at different levels of development. This story bible organizes the universe for the owner and readers invited to review it.

faq.question: Where should I begin?
faq.answer: Use Saga for the five-film overviews and detailed treatments. Character biographies follow documented appearances and milestones across the saga, rather than stopping at the film where a character is introduced.

faq.question: Does the site hide spoilers?
faq.answer: No. Full spoilers are intentional so shared readers can understand the story's complete scope.

faq.question: Are the later timelines fixed continuations?
faq.answer: No. Wolverine-series futures and post-Film-5 projects remain speculative. The story pages explain relevant boundaries where needed rather than presenting possible futures as settled events.

faq.question: Are the film titles final?
faq.answer: The displayed film titles are working labels. Alternative titles in the research may refer to the same project.
